title: Shinonome Ena — In Excruciating Twilight〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - School Festival
Stalls
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Let's see...
I think we've checked out every stall around here now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, that looks like a place where we can rest. Can we take a quick break...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I'd like that as well...
I'm actually getting a little thirsty.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay!
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Phew... Thank goodness we found a place where we can sit.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know, right...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But it hasn't been that long since we took our last break.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: These two are a bit lacking in terms of stamina.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll go grab some drinks from that stall. Any requests?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Umm... Anything is fine. Water, tea...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Same.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I also don't have any preferences.
Actually, should I go with you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, I should be fine since I'm going just over there! Anyway, I'll be right back.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks.
se_walk_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Kanade...?
You seem happy for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm happy to see Mizuki enjoying the festival like this...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, umm... I didn't really mean anything by that...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But based on the conversations we've been having while working recently, I feel like Mizuki's been a little low on energy.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Mizuki hasn't really been participating much in many of our recent conversations.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Is it because of that...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line: <Can we talk tomorrow during the night festival?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line: <I want to tell you...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line: <Everything that I couldn't until now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I didn't get to hear Mizuki say that since it was over chat, but something seemed a little off for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I guess that's only natural...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mizuki's been dealing with this issue for basically ever with no help from anybody else.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (After all that toiling and toiling and toiling, I'm being asked to hear what I'm guessing is gonna be the whole truth...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I have no idea what I'm going to hear...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But this is the school festival, so I'd rather have my friend enjoy it instead of worrying about all that.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Where's Mizuki...?
It's been like ten minutes already...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, it has been a while...
Maybe there was a long line.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll go take a look.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, if you're gonna go, then I'll also...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, Mizuki's just over there.
You two stay here.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Where's “over there”...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, isn't that Mizuki over by the shaved ice stall...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Shaved ice?
se_walk_women_001_2
se_walk_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks for lending me a hand, Mafuyu.
I'm surprised a helpless look was all it took for you to notice.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I noticed that you left the drinks stall empty-handed...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, you did? Anyway, you're a lifesaver.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry for making you two wait, Ena, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That's fine...
But weren't you going to buy drinks?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, but they were all sold out.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And when I started wondering what to do, I spotted the shaved ice stall next to it!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, you got us shaved ice instead?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup♪ Ice is just frozen water, so we can all rehydrate by having these.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, I shouldn't complain since you went to the trouble of getting us these.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, that's so considerate of you! For being so kind, I just might award you the star of the shaved ice world, blue raspberry!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That'll make my tongue blue. Can I have a different one?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What happened to not complaining...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: N-No, that was a request!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Alright, fine.
Just give me whatever you recommend, Mizuki.
